If the raw value for a temporal property value is not a string,
warn and discard the date.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            name:
            -   value: Someone
                # date requires a string.
                date: [array, instead, of, string]

-- want-errors --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name\[0\]: date discarded: expected date string, got

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
                entries:
                -   value: StringValue{"Someone"}
